$comment: Deliberately invalid versioned sentinel describing the format expected by @lumiboot/vm-assets (ensureImageManifest) for the desktop flavor. `files` is empty and the `$comment`/`status`/`notes` keys are rejected by the strict schema: this file can never simulate the presence of the image. The usable manifest is produced by build.sh (FLAVOR=desktop) then published into apps/web/public/images/ubuntu-18-i386-desktop/ (a Git-ignored directory), where a real boot validates it.
provenance: not documented (debootstrap against archive.ubuntu.com; no ISO is distributed)
notes: This file is a versioned template; the usable manifest lives in the `public` directory (Git-ignored) and a real boot validates it.
The image binaries are never committed to the repository.
The sha256 and size of disk/bzimage/initrd are filled in during the real build.
The catalog references the image (imageRef set) and availability stays derived from a validated boot (the profile's `validated`).
